data.narrative:
AstroForge, a Series A space and aerospace company founded by Matt Gialich and Jose Acain, has raised approximately $56M to date. Valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and Planet Labs, though the private set spans a wide stage range.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy base, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implying a valuation of $112M. Peer-median analysis across 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B Series B), Aalyria ($1.3B Series B), and Starcloud ($1.1B Seed)—yields a median of $1.3B, though this range ($1.1B–$2.0B) reflects stage heterogeneity. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (24.4x median across the 5 public names) cannot be applied without AstroForge's disclosed revenue.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $95M (low) to $1.5B (high), with a median of $706M. The wide dispersion reflects acute stage and comparability uncertainty: stage-progression yields a materially lower figure, while peer-median skews high given the presence of Series B stage competitors. Key uncertainties include AstroForge's revenue profile, technical milestones relative to peers, and customer validation, all of which would narrow this range considerably.
